sources.note: Village of Old Bennington, Warning for the annual meeting, May 12, 2026: two trustees are elected to two-year terms, on a five-member board

Village of Old Bennington, Trustees' Meeting Minutes, June 2, 2026 (the first meeting after the annual meeting): the trustees in office are Jim Thatch (named Presiding Officer at the reorganization), Renny Ponvert, Kristin Roessner, Ed Woods, and Susan Wright
Village of Old Bennington, Annual Report 2026: the trustees served through fiscal 2026, with Ed Woods as Presiding Officer
Village of Old Bennington, Warning for the annual meeting, May 12, 2026: a village clerk is elected for a one-year term
Village of Old Bennington, Trustees' Meeting Minutes, June 2, 2026 (the first meeting after the annual meeting): Mary Walsh signs as Village Clerk
Village of Old Bennington, Annual Report 2026: Mary Walsh served as Village Clerk through fiscal 2026; she is recorded as re-elected on incumbent continuity at the first post-election meeting
Village of Old Bennington, Warning for the annual meeting, May 12, 2026: a village treasurer is elected for a one-year term
Village of Old Bennington, Trustees' Meeting Minutes, June 2, 2026 (the first meeting after the annual meeting): Ron Rabidou presents the treasurer's report
Village of Old Bennington, Annual Report 2026: Ron Rabidou served as Village Treasurer through fiscal 2026; he is recorded as re-elected on incumbent continuity at the first post-election meeting
Village of Old Bennington, Warning for the annual meeting, May 12, 2026: a village auditor is elected for a one-year term
Village of Old Bennington, Trustees' Meeting Minutes, June 2, 2026 (the first meeting after the annual meeting): Kathy Wagenknecht presents the audit report of the fiscal 2026 books
Village of Old Bennington, Annual Report 2026: Kathy Wagenknecht served as auditor; she is recorded as re-elected on incumbent continuity at the first post-election meeting

Village of Old Bennington, Warning for the annual meeting, May 12, 2026: a moderator is elected for a one-year term; the seat stood at the May 12, 2026 annual meeting and no official source publishes the outcome, so the post is created without a membership
